articles.description: Even with the Mariners sitting 12 games under .500, neither Lazaro Montes or Michael Arroyo was in the lineup Wednesday evening against the Angels.

articles.title: Alan ‘Moose’ Clausen, longtime Mariners front office member, dies at 88
articles.description: Alan 'Moose' Clausen, who was a member of the Mariners' front office for over 30 years and a fixture of Seattle baseball, died Monday.

articles.title: Mariners seal first full losing season since 2019 with loss to Angels
articles.description: For the first time since 2019, a year they started a rebuild that was supposed to lead them to the World Series, the Mariners will finish with a losing record for a 162-game season.
